_note: Outputs of distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english (signed confidence: +p POSITIVE, -p NEGATIVE) and bert-base-uncased last-layer token vectors (stored as float16, from a copy of the ONNX graph whose output is the last encoder layer instead of the MLM logits), computed with the fp32 ONNX exports Xenova/* in transformers.js 3.5.1 (truncation to 512 tokens with [SEP] kept).
